question: Can a calibrated gain/tie/loss model learn available changes that E158 never takes?
objective: Three-category cross entropy for observed-graph Q(action)-Q(parent) in {-1,0,1}. Predict P(gain)-P(loss), with the parent defined to score0. Ties remain tie examples and never categorical parent demonstrations.
inputs: Previous public5339 action features plus the807-dimensional public descriptor of the actual parent recommendation. No seed, graph identity, RNG state, future reward or value is an input. Two hidden layers128/64 and three logits.
data: Exactly22311 nonparent observed actions at7448 branch states of the accepted E153 graph. All labels including tied outcomes retained. No parent-as-alternative examples; parent has identically zero advantage. All1536 source families keep previous outer and inner family roles.
sampler: Uniform fitting family, then branching state, then recorded nonparent alternative. Preserve class frequencies; no class balance weights. This replaces both the target and supervision unit as one expected-improvement design, not a one-factor attribution.
roles: Three excluding-family folds; inner whole-family validation uses8192 fixed draws and the8 previous step checkpoints, minimum three-class log loss, ties earlier. Refit outer-fit families for chosen steps. All saved inner checkpoints retained. At most12000 updates, plus8 discarded fixture updates.
support: Only action identities observed as nonparent comparisons in that model fitting families may override the parent; no per-state graph identity at deployment. This does not establish state-conditional coverage.
learning_gate: Before natural games require fitted known gains >=50% of fitted improvement-available branch appearances, fitted known gains > fitted known losses, and held known gains > held known losses. Full legal menus and fitting-only support determine choices; unrecorded outcomes are counted separately and never assigned a return. This is a prespecified feasibility screen, not a win rate or significance test. Main-task independent review is required.
natural_gate: If learning screen passes, same128 historical families, each under excluding-fold model, compare with frozen parent and E158. Require parent net gain>=8 and exact paired p<.025, zero faults, every state/RNG and NN choice checked and each winner freshly replanned. No automatic full fit, reserved development or final unseen acceptance.
limits: Exact recorded-graph maximum continuations use hidden future outcomes and optimistic recorded coverage; expected predictions and natural policy improvement are not guaranteed. E148/E150 MSE recipes failed and are not rerun. No new training sampling, original parity changes, parameter grid or production adoption.
